demos.title: Marchward
demos.description: A turn-based medieval siege game on a procedurally generated hex board, rendered as extruded terrain over a bounded real-world rectangle in CesiumJS. Officers lead armies of thousands, supply is traced from your castle, and you win by encircling the enemy keep and starving it before you storm it.

demos.title: How Many Moving Points Can CesiumJS Hold?
demos.description: Tens of thousands of ships, aircraft, ground vehicles and satellites moving at once as point primitives over ESRI imagery, with a live frame-budget breakdown, an auto-ramp that finds the breaking point, and a click-to-inspect swap from primitive to entity.

demos.title: Terrain-Following Airspace Volumes with PostGIS
demos.description: AGL airspace volumes tessellated into terrain-following 3D solids in PostGIS, with the pairwise conflict matrix computed in SQL — rendered over real satellite terrain at Stone Mountain, GA.

demos.title: Hello World
demos.description: A placeholder demo that proves the build pipeline and the landing page wiring work end to end.
